data.title: 一之濑帆波 · 雪夜路灯下的紧扣十指
data.description: 初雪纷纷飘落的深夜街角路灯下，厚厚的大衣与红围巾包裹着帆波微红的面庞。少女小心翼翼地伸出冻得通红的小手，主动探进你的大衣口袋里紧紧握住你的手指，抬起泛着水汽的眼眸——「手好冷呢……可以这样牵着一起走吗？」
data.action: 在雪中路灯下单手放进对方大衣口袋握紧，仰头期待害羞凝视
data.location: 飘雪的校园静谧路灯下
data.lighting: 路灯从上方洒下的金黄色光锥与漫天白雪反光
data.promptProse: Honami looks up from her red wool scarf, her long pink hair loose over a camel duffle coat. The boy beside her has dark-brown cropped hair, square brows and a navy pea coat. She slips her glove into his coat pocket to hold his hand beneath the lamppost while the snow falls around them.
data.animaCaption: Honami looks up from her red wool scarf, her long pink hair loose over a camel duffle coat. The boy beside her has dark-brown cropped hair, square brows and a navy pea coat. She slips her glove into his coat pocket to hold his hand beneath the lamppost while the snow falls around them.
